webhooks.detail: POST /v3/hooks with scopes like store/order/updated; delivery via HTTPS, Google Pub/Sub, Amazon EventBridge

evidence.quote: Subscribe to BigCommerce store events and receive real-time callbacks; configure scopes, payloads, and retries.

sandbox.detail: Partner Portal 'Partner Use Sandbox' stores for dev/testing (partner signup; price not stated); 15-day free trial also exists

evidence.quote: Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps. They cannot process any live transactions.

rate_limits.summary: OAuth apps: quota refreshed every 30s; plan-based, e.g. 150/30s Core/Growth, 450/30s Scale; X-Rate-Limit headers

evidence.quote: Apps using OAuth are rate-limited based on a quota that's refreshed every 30 seconds.
Tools and SDKs page lists a Node API Client (node-bigcommerce) and the Checkout SDK.
As of December 27, 2023, you can find all the public BigCommerce DevDocs at https://github.com/bigcommerce/docs!
